steps.sub: A venv protects other projects from this course's package installs

steps.label: venv vs. conda
steps.sub: venv ships with Python; conda also installs non-Python dependencies

steps.label: The core install
steps.sub: pip install numpy scipy matplotlib jupyter

steps.label: requirements.txt
steps.sub: Pins exact versions so the environment is reproducible later

code:
python -m venv .venv

# macOS/Linux
source .venv/bin/activate

# Windows PowerShell
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1

pip install numpy scipy matplotlib jupyter
caption: Everything installed while a venv is active is invisible to every other project on the machine.

code:
# requirements.txt
numpy==2.1.0
scipy==1.14.0
matplotlib==3.9.0
jupyter==1.1.0

pip install -r requirements.txt
caption: A different NumPy minor version can silently change a numerical result — pinning avoids that exact bug.
